products.label: Products
products.help: Creates new products. SKU must be unique. Unit must match a unit code in your catalog. Opening stock is added to the current store. Prices include GST; cost excludes GST.

stock.label: Stock entries
stock.help: Changes stock for existing SKUs in the current store. Quantity is a change (+ received / − removed), not a replacement balance. Blank batch means unbatched stock. Expiry uses YYYY-MM-DD. Use Purchases for supplier invoices and cost changes.

customers.label: Customers
customers.help: Creates new customers. Duplicate mobile numbers or duplicate names with the same address are rejected. Opening balance is money owed to your store.

suppliers.label: Suppliers
suppliers.help: Creates new suppliers. Duplicate mobile numbers or duplicate company names with the same address are rejected. Opening balance is money your store owes.
